messages:
Rhea: Dropping a short working thread: we need a lightweight launch canvas for the routing + multi-tenant isolation initiative that product/eng/sales can agree on. Keep to testable gates and customer promises.
Liam: Suggest break into three top deliverables: policy controller, rollout service, and per-tenant telemetry + billing. Each should be feature-flagged.
Priya: Gate ideas: determinism (policy precedence unit tests), isolation (noisy-tenant experiment), variant safety (shadow evals for quantized models), and residency (end-to-end residency verification).
Noah: Ops thresholds to include: p95 alert if >20% increase for 10m, p99 alert if >8% increase for 5m, auto-quarantine after 60s sustained anomaly. Need a simple circuit-breaker: tenant->min(10qps,reserved_qps).
Zara: From sales: customers want clear contract language for residency (hard vs soft), burst pools (size + refill), and a SLA checklist: latency SLO, eviction SLA, audit retention.
Rhea: Proposed minimal launch gates (brief): 1) Observability: per-tenant + per-variant dashboards + 30d cost attribution; 2) Canary: <0.5% traffic with automatic rollback on policy regression; 3) Isolation: noisy-tenant sim passes (neighbors p99 delta <5%); 4) Economics: median cost delta <=12% on baselines; 5) Compliance: residency flag proven by packet-trace audit.
Liam: Implementation notes: controller must emit policy_id and model_variant in decision log. Rollout API should accept percent and variant filters. No global flips 94 only percent ramps.
Priya: For model variants: require a shadow-eval job that runs customer prompt set against baseline and candidate variant. Gate = L1 metric delta <1% OR explicit customer opt-in. Record shadow-eval result in audit trail.
Noah: Load test sketch: mixed-tenant replay at 2x for 60m, inject noisy tenant with hot-key churn, ensure eviction triggers and failover completes within 120s, verify neighbor p50/p95/p99 stability.
Zara: I'll assemble a one-page customer checklist: persona mapping (preview/committed/enterprise), residency options, burst tiers, and sample contract bullets.
Rhea: Owners & short actions: Priya -> gating matrix w/ pass/fail defs (Tue EOD); Liam -> RFC for controller + rollout API (Wed); Noah -> load test & runbook (Wed); Zara -> customer checklist (Thu).
audit-bot: Note: audit-log retention is 90d by default. If contracts require longer, include a retention exception in the RFC.
Rhea: Let's meet Fri 10am to review the RFC + gating matrix. Keep language tight so we can copy this into the Q3 roadmap doc. Thanks :thumbsup:
